# Extract add/remove suggestions from the Todoist comments already fetched (all_comments)
adds = []
removes = []
for c in all_comments:
    content = c.get('content') or ''
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith('add =>'):
            payload = line[len('add =>'):].strip()
            # split last ' by '
            if ' by ' in payload:
                title, artists_str = payload.rsplit(' by ', 1)
            else:
                title, artists_str = payload, ''
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',') if a.strip()]
            adds.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})
        elif line.startswith('remove =>'):
            payload = line[len('remove =>'):].strip()
            if ' by ' in payload:
                title, artists_str = payload.rsplit(' by ', 1)
            else:
                title, artists_str = payload, ''
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',') if a.strip()]
            removes.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})

# Deduplicate by (title, tuple(artists))

# Apply Spotify playlist changes based on Todoist comments

from copy import deepcopy

playlist_id = 654
current_songs = playlist.get('songs') or []
# Map current songs by normalized title and artist names set

def norm(s):
    return (s or '').strip().lower()

def artists_norm_list(song):
    return [norm(a.get('name')) for a in (song.get('artists') or [])]

# Determine song_ids to remove by matching title and artist list exactly (order-insensitive)
remove_targets = removes_dedup
remove_ids = []
for r in remove_targets:
    rt = norm(r['title'])
    rartists = sorted([norm(a) for a in r['artists']])
    matched = []
    for s in current_songs:
        st = norm(s.get('title'))
        sarts = sorted(artists_norm_list(s))
        if st == rt and sarts == rartists:
            matched.append(s.get('id'))
    if matched:
        # if multiple, remove all matched IDs
        remove_ids.extend(matched)
    else:
        print('WARNING: No exact match found in current playlist for remove:', r)

# Dedup
remove_ids = list(dict.fromkeys([int(x) for x in remove_ids]))
print('Remove song_ids:', remove_ids)

# Remove songs
remove_results = []
for sid in remove_ids:
    res = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_access_token)
    remove_results.append(res)
    print('Removed', sid, '=>', res)

# Add songs: search and find exact matches
add_targets = adds_dedup

def search_all_songs(query, page_limit=20, max_pages=50):
    all_found = []
    page_index = 0
    while page_index < max_pages:
        page = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, access_token=spotify_access_token)
        if not page:
            break
        all_found.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return all_found

add_song_ids = []
add_resolution = []
for a in add_targets:
    title = a['title']
    expected_artists = a['artists']
    # search query: title plus first artist to reduce ambiguity
    q = title
    if expected_artists:
        q = f"{title} {expected_artists[0]}"
    print('Searching for add candidate:', title, 'artists:', expected_artists, 'query used:', q)
    songs_found = search_all_songs(query=q, page_limit=20)
    # Find exact matches
    rt = norm(title)
    expected_sorted = sorted([norm(x) for x in expected_artists])
    exact = []
    for s in songs_found:
        st = norm(s.get('title'))
        sarts_sorted = sorted([norm(ar.get('name')) for ar in (s.get('artists') or [])])
        if st == rt and sarts_sorted == expected_sorted:
            exact.append(s.get('song_id'))
    if exact:
        song_id_to_add = int(exact[0])
        # If multiple exact, choose first but we can add all? We'll add only one to avoid duplicates.
    else:
        # Fall back to title-only exact match if available
        exact_title = []
        for s in songs_found:
            if norm(s.get('title')) == rt:
                exact_title.append(s.get('song_id'))
        if not exact_title:
            print('WARNING: No matches found for add candidate title:', title)
            continue
        song_id_to_add = int(exact_title[0])
        print('WARNING: Artist match not exact; using first title match song_id', song_id_to_add)

    add_resolution.append({'title': title, 'expected_artists': expected_artists, 'song_id': song_id_to_add, 'query': q, 'found_candidates': len(songs_found)})
    add_song_ids.append(song_id_to_add)

# Dedup add_song_ids
add_song_ids = list(dict.fromkeys([int(x) for x in add_song_ids]))
print('Add song_ids:', add_song_ids)

# Add songs
add_results = []
for sid in add_song_ids:
    res = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_access_token)
    add_results.append(res)
    print('Added', sid, '=>', res)

print('Add resolution:')
for r in add_resolution:
    print(r)

# Todoist: post final comment and mark task complete
comment_content = "Incorporated changes."
post_res = apis.todoist.post_task_comment(task_id=6342, content=comment_content, access_token=todoist_access_token)
print('Posted final comment =>', post_res)

update_res = apis.todoist.update_task(task_id=6342, access_token=todoist_access_token, is_completed=True)
print('Marked Todoist task complete =>', update_res)

# Add Spotify songs to playlist based on extracted Todoist comments.
# Assumes: spotify_access_token, playlist_after/songs_after already available from prior steps.

playlist_id = 654

# Current songs in playlist (from the most recent fetch)
current_playlist_songs = None
if 'songs_after' in globals() and songs_after:
    current_playlist_songs = songs_after
elif 'playlist_after' in globals() and playlist_after:
    current_playlist_songs = playlist_after.get('songs') or []
else:
    current_playlist_songs = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_access_token).get('songs') or []

print('Current playlist size (before additions):', len(current_playlist_songs))


def norm(x):
    return (x or '').strip().lower()

def song_key(song):
    title = norm(song.get('title'))
    artists = sorted([norm(a.get('name')) for a in (song.get('artists') or [])])
    return (title, tuple(artists))

current_keys = {song_key(s) for s in current_playlist_songs}
print('Current keys sample:', list(current_keys)[:3])

# Add targets extracted earlier
add_targets = adds_dedup if 'adds_dedup' in globals() else []
print('Add targets count:', len(add_targets))
for a in add_targets:
    expected_key = (norm(a['title']), tuple(sorted([norm(x) for x in a.get('artists') or []])))
    print('Target:', a['title'], '| expected artists:', a.get('artists') ,'| already in playlist?', expected_key in current_keys)


def search_all_songs(query, page_limit=20, max_pages=50):
    all_found = []
    page_index = 0
    while page_index < max_pages:
        page = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        all_found.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return all_found


def find_exact_song_id(title, expected_artists):
    expected_sorted = sorted([norm(x) for x in (expected_artists or [])])
    q = title
    if expected_artists:
        q = f"{title} {expected_artists[0]}"
    print('Searching:', q)
    songs_found = search_all_songs(query=q, page_limit=20)
    print('  candidates found:', len(songs_found))

    # Exact match: title + full artist set
    for s in songs_found:
        if norm(s.get('title')) != norm(title):
            continue
        sarts_sorted = sorted([norm(a.get('name')) for a in (s.get('artists') or [])])
        if sarts_sorted == expected_sorted:
            return int(s.get('song_id')) if s.get('song_id') is not None else int(s.get('id'))

    # Fallback: title-only match
    title_matches = [s for s in songs_found if norm(s.get('title')) == norm(title)]
    if title_matches:
        chosen = title_matches[0]
        print('  WARNING: exact artist match not found; using first title match')
        return int(chosen.get('song_id')) if chosen.get('song_id') is not None else int(chosen.get('id'))

    print('  WARNING: no match found for title:', title)
    return None


# Resolve song ids for targets not already in playlist
songs_to_add = []
add_resolution = []
for a in add_targets:
    title = a['title']
    expected_artists = a.get('artists') or []
    expected_key = (norm(title), tuple(sorted([norm(x) for x in expected_artists])))
    if expected_key in current_keys:
        continue
    song_id = find_exact_song_id(title, expected_artists)
    add_resolution.append({'title': title, 'expected_artists': expected_artists, 'resolved_song_id': song_id})
    if song_id is not None:
        songs_to_add.append(song_id)

print('Resolved songs_to_add:', songs_to_add)
print('Add resolution:', add_resolution)

# Add to playlist
add_results = []
for sid in songs_to_add:
    res = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_access_token)
    add_results.append({'song_id': sid, 'res': res})
    print('Added song_id', sid, '=>', res)

print('Add operation completed. Total songs after (not verified yet).')
